def build_generic(Io):
    Hh,Ww=len(Io),len(Io[0])
    cntt=Counter(v for row in Io for v in row)
    border=max((v,n) for v,n in cntt.items() if v!=0)[0]
    # box starts: rows/cols where border appears, boxes of width 5 (border+3)

        if c==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(c)

    groups.append(cur)
    cstarts=[g[0] for g in groups]
    brows_=sorted({r for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if Io[r][c]==border})
    groups=[];cur=[brows_[0]]
    for r in brows_[1:]:

    groups.append(cur)
